svg.title: CMMC agent jobs by price (Fixed USD)
svg.text: CMMC agent jobs by price — Fixed USD
Catalog as recorded 2026-11-06. Require Funds ON for every job. Agent instance offline — no hire can be fulfilled today.
Bars scaled to price; $150 bar is the full width. Subscription not shown here: compliance_watch, $20 per 30 days.
Source: CMMC agent catalog on Virtuals Protocol (ACP), as recorded 2026-11-06; see cmmc.agifuturefoundation.org/jobs.html.
The agent is a readiness advisor, not a certifier. It cannot grant, guarantee, or substitute for CMMC certification.
